description: Browse four of Apple's catalogs. catalog "technologies": every Apple framework and technology, grouped by Apple's categories, each with its link, languages, tags and Apple's one-line summary, beta ones marked; use it to see which frameworks fit a task (category "Machine learning") or to get a framework's exact name and link. catalog "samples": Apple's Sample Code Library, each sample with its framework, sections and summary, featured ones first, then by the library's sections ("WWDC26" holds that year's); to find a sample by what it does, search_apple_docs with type "sample" ranks every sample on the site, including ones this library leaves out. catalog "updates": Apple's Updates page as links with summaries, each framework's updates page ("SwiftUI updates"), the release notes of each OS, Xcode and Safari, and each past WWDC's What's new page; use it to find what changed in a framework or a release. catalog "overviews": Apple's Technology Overviews, guides to which technologies to use for a goal (app design and UI, Liquid Glass, games, AI and machine learning and more), the collections with their summaries and the articles in each; use it to choose an approach before choosing APIs. Read any entry with get_apple_doc_content. The technologies and samples answers also name a TSV of the whole catalog, one entry a line, for a grep the parameters can't make.

catalog.description: "technologies": Apple's frameworks and technologies; "samples": Apple's Sample Code Library; "updates": Apple's Updates page; "overviews": Apple's Technology Overviews.

category.description: Keeps one part of the catalog, in any case: technologies, the ones whose category or one of whose tags contains it ("Machine learning" finds Core ML, Create ML and Vision); samples, a library section, by any part of its name ("WWDC26" lists that year's samples); updates, a section of the page, by any part of its title ("Release notes"); overviews, one collection, by its whole title or the last part of its link. Technologies, updates and overviews answer a value they lack with the ones they have.

framework.description: samples only: keeps the samples whose framework, title or link names this framework, in any spelling ("SwiftUI", "storekit", "Core ML").

includeBeta.description: false leaves out beta technologies, samples or updates.

includeSubcategories.description: overviews only: false lists only the collections, without their articles.

language.description: technologies only: keeps the technologies available in Swift ("swift") or Objective-C ("occ").

limit.description: Most entries to show, in all; if left out, 200 technologies, 50 samples, 50 updates, 50 overview entries.

searchQuery.description: samples: words that must all appear, in any case, in a sample's title, sections, framework, link or summary ("SwiftData widget"); the list keeps the library's order. updates: keeps the entries whose title or summary contains this text, in any case. overviews: keeps the collections and articles whose title or link contains this text, in any case; a collection's summary counts too.

technology.description: updates only: keeps the entries whose framework, title or summary contains this name ("SwiftUI"), in any case.

name: list_technologies
title: List Technologies
